run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T07:52:32Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend is explained by the checkout service becoming unavailable. Events show chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay spawning PodChaos experiments from 07:51:25Z, and all 10 PodChaos 'Applied' events in the window name otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q. That pod's container spec now carries image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest while its ReplicaSet and Deployment still specify ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout; the pod is not ready, has 11 restarts, last terminated with exit code 2 (reason Error) and is in CrashLoopBackOff, and the checkout Service endpoint lists only a notReady address. Checkout's PlaceOrder span rate fell from 0.27-0.54 spans/s to exactly 0 from 07:54Z, and the frontend's error-status spans - only on the checkout path (grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, POST /api/checkout, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout, tcp.connect) - rose from 0 before 07:52Z to 0.82-2.39 spans/s, with frontend-proxy errors rising from 0-0.033/s to 0.39-1.13/s. A pod-failure-style injection is the hypothesis that best matches the pause-image swap; the PodChaos action field itself could not be read. Alternatives were checked and rejected: flagd fault flags (all defaultVariant off), a checkout Deployment rollout (template, ReplicaSet and pod name unchanged), and a product-catalog fault (pod ready, 0 restarts, 0 error spans).

claims.text: At 2026-11-17T07:52:32Z the frontend service's error-status span rates were confined to the checkout path: grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder 0.0556/s, POST /api/checkout 0.0556/s, executing api route (pages) /api/checkout 0.0556/s, POST 0.0556/s and tcp.connect 0.0259/s, while GET, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, POST /api/cart and all ad/cart client operations had error rate 0.

The summed frontend error-status span rate was 0 at every evaluation from 07:20Z to 07:51:32Z, first became non-zero at the 07:52:32Z evaluation, and stayed between 0.82 and 2.39 spans/s through 08:03Z, matching the alert start time of 2026-11-17T07:52:32Z.

The checkout service's own spans carry no error status: at 07:52:32Z every checkout span_name (HTTP POST, oteldemo.CartService/EmptyCart and GetCart, oteldemo.CurrencyService/Convert, oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge, oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct, prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart, orders publish, oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder) had status_code STATUS_CODE_UNSET only, with no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series.
The checkout oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span rate was 0.27-0.54 spans/s until the 07:53:00Z evaluation and dropped to exactly 0 from 07:54:00Z through 08:04:00Z, so checkout stopped serving.

Pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q in namespace otel-demo is Running but not ready: container checkout has restarts 11, lastState terminated with exitCode 2, reason Error, startedAt 07:58:20Z and finishedAt 07:58:25Z, and current state waiting with reason CrashLoopBackOff and message 'back-off 2m40s restarting failed container=checkout pod=checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q_otel-demo(...)'.

The checkout pod's spec container 'checkout' now has image gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest, while its status container image is ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout with imageID sha256:f000c1de37175546a22846714e1c11a19bc2997e8769bb7bffcab5c4c10c24b2; Deployment 'checkout' and ReplicaSet 'checkout-5dccddf8bb' still specify image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout.

chaos-mesh events show Schedule 'otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay' in namespace chaos-mesh creating PodChaos 'otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay-zv9mn', which logged 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q' at 07:51:25Z; further PodChaos instances applied chaos to the same checkout pod at 07:52:25Z (927gn), 07:53:25Z (d2m7w), 07:54:25Z (dc4vz), 07:55:25Z (jgn2n), 07:56:25Z (ktl9k), 07:57:25Z (vxxwz), 07:58:25Z (6cwbh), 07:59:25Z (qgddz) and 08:00:25Z (gl228), each with TimeUp/Recovered about 55s later.
All 10 PodChaos 'Applied' events in the window carry the same message, 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q', so the chaos target was only this checkout pod.

Pod events for checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q record 'Container checkout definition changed, will be restarted' (reason Killing) at 07:54:25Z, the same second PodChaos dc4vz applied chaos, then container image 'gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest already present on machine' at 07:57:52Z, and Warning 'Back-off restarting failed container checkout in pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q' at 07:59:13Z.
The checkout Service endpoint has no ready address: its only subset entry is 100.96.4.26 under notReadyAddresses, matching the not-ready checkout pod IP.

frontend-proxy's error-status span rate was 0-0.033/s before 07:51:32Z and rose to 0.39-1.13 spans/s from the 07:52:32Z evaluation onward; at 07:52:32Z its 'ingress' spans were 0.0704/s STATUS_CODE_ERROR against 12.4667/s STATUS_CODE_UNSET.

Other services show no incident-time change rather than failure: payment and accounting error-status span rates were 0 across the window, and ad, fraud-detection and recommendation show only sporadic 0.0037/s errors both before the onset (07:37:32Z, 07:42:32Z) and after (07:57:32Z, 08:07:32Z), i.e. background; the service-grouped error query returned no ERROR series for cart, shipping, currency, email, product-catalog or checkout.

The checkout service itself never reported error spans (all STATUS_CODE_UNSET), so the failure is that calls stopped reaching checkout after 07:54Z rather than an application-level error returned by checkout.

The injection acted as a pod-failure-style fault: replacing the checkout container image with gcr.io/google-containers/pause:latest made checkout unavailable (endpoint notReady, CrashLoopBackOff), so the frontend's grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder calls failed (frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR plus tcp.connect errors) and frontend returned 5xx, which frontend-proxy propagated as ingress errors and which produced the RequestErrorRate alert. It remains a hypothesis because the PodChaos action field could not be read, and the object's name references 'network-delay', which does not by itself explain an image swap and container restart.

flagd feature-flag fault injection as the cause is rejected: all 12 flags in ConfigMap flagd-config (adFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, paymentUnreachable, productCatalogFailure, recommendationCacheFailure) have defaultVariant 'off', and the failing path is checkout-unreachable, not payment or product-catalog error returns (payment and accounting error rates were 0).

A checkout Deployment rollout or template change as the cause is rejected: Deployment 'checkout' still specifies ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, it has a single ReplicaSet checkout-5dccddf8bb owned by Deployment checkout, the pod kept the name checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q, and no SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete of a replacement checkout pod appears - the change was made to the running pod's own container spec.

A product-catalog fault (the chaos object's name references product-catalog) is rejected: pod product-catalog-7c7f8b68dc-q8nt8 is Running, ready, 0 restarts, image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-product-catalog; no product-catalog error span series was returned; frontend grpc.oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct spans had error rate 0 at 10.64 spans/s; and every PodChaos Applied event names the checkout pod, not product-catalog.

Read the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay and its PodChaos objects to confirm the action and intent; if unintended, stop or pause the schedule, confirm the checkout pod container image returns to ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-checkout, then delete pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q so the Deployment recreates a clean pod and clears CrashLoopBackOff. If intended, correct the misleading name (it targets the checkout pod, not product-catalog) and verify the action matches the expected fault.

gaps: The PodChaos and Schedule specs were not readable with the available tools, so the experiment's action (pod-failure versus a latency action), duration and selector could not be verified; the pause-image swap is the only direct evidence of fault type, so the causal mechanism is stated as a hypothesis.

Checkout crash-time application logs are unavailable: fetch_pod_logs reported no previous container instance and the current checkout container lines end at 2026-11-17T07:37:34Z; that log view was incomplete, showing only the newest 100 of 2239 matching lines, so the reason for exit code 2 at 07:58:25Z was not read from logs.

A filtered fetch_pod_logs query on pod checkout-5dccddf8bb-9dn2q for 07:48-08:05Z with an error/timeout filter returned status no_data, and a similar filtered query on frontend-675fd7b5c5-gc9hg returned status no_data with 0 lines read, so frontend and checkout error text was not confirmed from logs.

A traces_search for service frontend over 07:50-08:00Z returned status no_data with no spans, so no per-trace error detail or supplied parent reference confirming a frontend-to-checkout call edge was available from Jaeger.

list_prometheus_rules returned status no_data both unfiltered and for rule_name RequestErrorRate, so the alert expression and its reported current value 3.4999999999999996 could not be reproduced; the observed frontend-proxy ingress error share at 07:52:32Z was 0.0704 out of 12.5371 spans/s (about 0.56%), which does not obviously correspond to 3.5.

kube-state-metrics series were not available: get_metric_names for {__name__=~"kube_.*"} returned no_data, and kube_pod_container_info and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available queries both returned no_data, so pod restart counts and Deployment availability exist only as API-server object state at query time.

get_label_values for rpc_grpc_status_code on service_name=checkout and get_all_labels for rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count both returned no_data, so gRPC status codes and that metric's label coverage are unknown rather than zero.
Queries for ResourceQuota and NetworkPolicy in otel-demo returned status no_data, so their absence cannot be asserted and they were not excluded as contributing factors.
The event view ends at 2026-11-17T08:00:48Z, so chaos activity after that, and which PodChaos instance is currently applied given the pod spec image was still the pause image at 08:11Z, is unknown.
The change_history integration is not available, so who created or modified the chaos Schedule could not be determined.
next_steps: Have a cluster operator read the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-product-catalog-network-delay and its PodChaos CRs (spec.action, spec.mode, selector, duration, schedule) to confirm the injected fault type and its owner.
Diff the running checkout pod spec against the checkout Deployment template to confirm the pause-image mutation is chaos injection, then restore the container image.
Review the alert rule behind RequestErrorRate to reconcile the reported value 3.5 with the observed error-span and ingress metrics.
